set.description: A session's own window (ssh-<token> / rdp-<token>, session.html). Drives the one session it renders: SSH/RDP input and resize, the RDP frame channel, close, liveness, Move to workspace, asking before its native close and closing itself (session_window_closing / session_window_close, T108 — the calling window only, never another by label), the session-input preferences it reads, and the Rustion chip's read / renew / end (session_rustion_info / _renew / _kill, T145: each takes the session token, and the host takes the bastion, session and correlation ids from the bundle it stashed at open, never from the webview). Every input command and the three Rustion commands are further narrowed by the host to the window holding the session (attachments::authorize_input); the raw-id rustion_session_renew / _kill stay in the main window's set only. No vault reads, no session opens, no token. Derived from what session.html's own-window routes call; gui/src/test/sessionBundle.test.ts keeps the two equal. Features/session-workspace.md, T110.

An SFTP session's own window (sftp-<token>, session.html). Drives the one SFTP session it renders: remote listing, folder creation, rename, delete, transfers and their cancel; the local pane's listing, home and folder creation; close, liveness, asking before its native close and closing itself; for a session brokered through a Rustion bastion (T141), reading its bastion lifecycle bundle and renewing or terminating that bastion session (session_rustion_info / _renew / _kill), as an SSH window does. Every sftp_* command and the three Rustion lifecycle commands take the session token and are refused by the host unless the calling window holds that live session (require_session_window); the Rustion commands act only on the bastion session stashed for that token (T145), so the local-filesystem commands are unusable without one. No keystroke or RDP input, no vault reads, no session opens, no token. Derived from what session.html's /session/sftp route calls; gui/src/test/sessionBundle.test.ts keeps the two equal. Features/sftp-connect.md.

The Session Workspace window (session-workspace, session.html). Everything a session window may call, plus: the listing and placement hand-off (session_list_open), the saved layout (session_layout_save / _get / _forget), and the normal connect path its ⌘T palette and explicit layout restore go through — the resource reads that path needs (list_resources, read_resource, resource_types_read), connect-time MFA (connect_mfa_*), the credential-provider account list for the host-rendered picker (connect_provider_candidates: metadata only, features/self-accounts.md §6) and session_open_ssh / _rdp / _web / _sftp (an SFTP session always opens its own window), each still behind the host's connect gate, transport tier and MFA ticket check. No secret reads, no credential release to the frontend, no admin command, no vault token. Derived from what the /workspace route calls; gui/src/test/sessionBundle.test.ts keeps the two equal. Features/session-workspace.md, T110.

A recording replay window (replay-<id>, session.html): reads the one recording it plays. Derived from what the /session-replay route calls; gui/src/test/sessionBundle.test.ts keeps the two equal. Features/session-workspace.md, T110.

A web session's toolbar webview (webchrome-<token>, web-chrome.html): its three commands, each bound by the host to the session the calling webview sits in (session::web_chrome::chrome_caller). Features/web-application-connect.md Phase 5.
